title: Ejara Admin Panel — Fiat Wallet Module Test Plan (v2)
scope: Wallet Account List (Main/Jara/Rewards tabs), Account List Filters, Account Details, Account-level Transactions List with Filters, Transaction Details, Manual Deposit (Cash in), Manual Withdrawal (Cash out), the module-level Transactions page (Deposits / Withdrawals / Sales / Purchases) with its filters and transaction details, the Complete-transaction flow for failed deposits, and the CS wallet-issue resolution paths documented in Figma.
deferred: Export Statement (full flow) and Statistics: no screens designed yet (Figma 'Documentation — Export Statement Flow' and 'Statistics Flow' list them as missing). Only the Export entry point is tested.
designNotes: Values on Figma screens are representative only: tests check structure, labels, behaviour and consistency, not the sample numbers/names.

Figma copy defects are flagged as design feedback (e.g. TOTP info box on review screens, 'Manage your team members…' subtitle on the account filter panel, 'Manual deposit' breadcrumb on the Complete-transaction review step).
Gaps listed in Figma 'Missing (Gap from PRD)' blocks are not tested as features; they are listed in the report for product/design follow-up.

sections.name: Wallet Account List
sections.pre: Agent is logged into the Admin Panel with a CS role; Fiat Wallet > Account list is available; at least one account exists on the Main, Jara, and Rewards wallet tabs.

cases.title: Account list displays all accounts with a wallet, with correct columns
steps: Observe the table columns and populated rows.
cases.expected: Table shows a select-all checkbox, then Full name, Username (@handle), Total balance, Status, Registration date and a 'See details' action for every account that has this wallet type (Figma 190:2151).
cases.note: Expected now lists the exact Figma column set incl. Full name and the row checkbox.

cases.title: List defaults to the 'Main wallet' tab on entry
steps: Navigate to Fiat Wallet > Account list.
cases.expected: 'Main wallet' tab is selected by default and its accounts are shown.

cases.title: Switching to 'Jara wallet' tab loads Jara wallet accounts
cases.expected: List reloads to show only accounts/balances for the Jara wallet, with the same column structure.

cases.title: Switching to 'Rewards' tab loads Rewards wallet accounts
cases.expected: List reloads to show only accounts/balances for the Rewards wallet, with the same column structure.

cases.title: Search by full name filters the list to the matching account(s)
steps: Enter a known account's full name (or part of it) in the search box.
cases.expected: List narrows to only account(s) whose name matches the search term.

cases.title: Search by username filters the list to the matching account(s)
steps: Enter a known account's username (e.g. '@philippe10') in the search box.
cases.expected: List narrows to only the account whose username matches the search term.

cases.title: Search with a term matching no account shows the empty state
steps: Enter a search term that matches no account (e.g. random string).
cases.expected: An empty-state illustration and message are shown instead of table rows (Figma 230:8643).

cases.title: Empty-state copy correctly refers to wallet accounts
steps: Trigger the empty state via a non-matching search.
Read the empty-state title and description text.
cases.expected: Copy references wallet accounts (e.g. 'No accounts found'). Flag if it reads 'No vendors found' (Figma leftover) or a generic 'No data'.
cases.note: Now automated: asserts the copy mentions accounts.

cases.title: 'Per page' selector changes the number of rows shown
steps: Change the 'Per page' dropdown value (e.g. from 8 to a larger value).
cases.expected: Table re-renders with the selected number of rows per page; pagination updates accordingly.

cases.title: Pagination page-number controls navigate correctly
steps: Click page '2' (or another page number) in the pagination control.
cases.expected: List updates to show the corresponding page's accounts; active page indicator updates.

cases.title: Pagination next/previous arrows move one page at a time
cases.expected: Each click moves exactly one page forward/backward; arrows disable appropriately at the first/last page.

cases.title: Result count label reflects the current tab/filter/page
steps: Note the 'Showing X to Y of Z results' label.
Switch tabs, apply a filter, or change page.
cases.expected: The label updates to accurately reflect the current result set and page position after each change.

cases.title: Refresh icon reloads the current list
steps: Click the refresh icon above the table.
cases.expected: A loading state is shown briefly, then the list reloads with current data, tab, and filters preserved.

cases.title: 'See details' navigates to the correct account's detail page
steps: Click 'See details' on a specific account row (note the username shown).
cases.expected: Account Details page opens for that exact account (username/name match the row clicked).

cases.title: Balances display in the correct currency format
steps: Inspect the 'Total balance' column values across several rows.
cases.expected: All balances are shown with the XAF currency suffix and consistent thousands separators/decimals.

cases.title: Status badge displays the correct color/label per account state
steps: Locate accounts with different statuses (Active, Suspended, Deactivated) in the list.
cases.expected: Each status renders as a badge with its own colour and a capitalised label (Figma: green dot + 'Active').

cases.title: Page header shows title and description
cases.expected: Title 'Account list' and description 'The list should show every user who has a Wallet.' are shown; breadcrumb reads 'Account list'.
cases.note: From Figma 190:2151 header.

cases.title: Select-all checkbox selects and clears every row on the page
cases.expected: All visible rows become selected, then all are cleared.
cases.note: Figma shows row + header checkboxes on the list.

cases.title: Single-row checkbox toggles only that row
cases.expected: Only the clicked rows change state; other rows are unaffected.

cases.title: 'Export' button is present on the Account list
steps: Locate the 'Export' button next to Filters.
cases.expected: Button is visible. The export flow itself is deferred pending design.
cases.note: Figma 'Account List Flow — Designed: Export button'.

cases.title: Default sort shows the most recent accounts first
steps: Read the Registration date of the first rows.
cases.expected: Rows are sorted by most recent activity first (Figma doc step 02: 'default sorting by recent activity'); at minimum registration dates are in descending order.

cases.title: Result count on the empty state reads zero
steps: Trigger the empty state via a non-matching search.
cases.expected: Label reads 'Showing 0 to 0 of 0 results' (never 'Showing 1 to 0').

cases.title: Clearing the search restores the full list
cases.expected: The full, unfiltered list and its original result count are restored.

sections.name: Account List Filters
sections.pre: Agent is logged into the Admin Panel with a CS role; Fiat Wallet > Account list is available; at least one account exists on the Main, Jara, and Rewards wallet tabs.

cases.title: 'Filters' panel opens with Account status, Balance range, and Creation date fields
steps: Click the 'Filters' button on the Account list.
cases.expected: A 'Filter by' panel opens showing Account status (multi-select chips), Balance range (Start amount / End amount, XAF prefix), and Creation date (start/end) fields, with Reset and Apply filters buttons.
cases.note: Field labels aligned with Figma 291:6675.

cases.title: Filtering by a single account status returns only matching accounts
cases.expected: List shows only accounts with Active status; result count updates accordingly.

cases.title: Filtering by multiple account statuses returns accounts matching any of them
cases.expected: Both statuses can be selected at once (chips) and the list shows accounts whose status is either value (OR logic within the same field).

cases.title: Removing a status chip excludes it from the applied filter
steps: Open Filters with two or more statuses selected.
Click the 'x' on one status chip.
cases.expected: The removed status is no longer part of the filter criteria; results update accordingly.

cases.title: Filtering by balance range returns only accounts within that range
steps: Enter a start and end amount in Balance range.
cases.expected: Only accounts whose Total balance falls within the specified range are shown.

cases.title: Balance range with start amount greater than end amount is handled gracefully
steps: Enter a start amount higher than the end amount.
cases.expected: System either blocks submission with a validation message or auto-corrects the range; it does not silently return incorrect/empty results without explanation.

cases.title: Filtering by creation date range returns only accounts registered within that range
steps: Choose a start and end date under Creation date.
cases.expected: Only accounts with a Registration date within the selected range are shown.

cases.title: Date-range quick options apply the correct range
steps: Open Filters, open the date picker.
Select each quick option in turn (Today, Yesterday, Last 7 days, Last 30 days, Last 60 days, Last 90 days) and apply.
cases.expected: Each quick option populates the start/end dates correctly and filters results to that exact window.

cases.title: Combining status, balance range, and date filters applies AND logic across fields
steps: Set an account status, a balance range, and a creation date range together.
cases.expected: Only accounts satisfying all three conditions simultaneously are returned.

cases.title: 'Apply filters' is disabled until a filter value is set
steps: Open Filters without changing any field.
cases.expected: Button remains disabled until at least one filter criterion is set or changed.

cases.title: 'Reset' clears all selected filter values
steps: Open Filters and set several values.
cases.expected: All filter fields return to their default/empty state without closing the panel.

cases.title: Applied filters show an active-filter count badge on the 'Filters' button
steps: Apply two filter criteria (e.g. status + balance range).
cases.expected: Button shows a badge/count (e.g. '2') indicating the number of active filter criteria.

cases.title: Closing the filter panel without applying discards unsaved changes
steps: Open Filters and change a value.
Click the 'X' to close the panel without clicking Apply.
cases.expected: The unsaved change is not applied to the list and is not retained when the panel is reopened.

cases.title: Filter state when switching wallet tabs is well-defined
steps: Apply a filter on the 'Main wallet' tab.
Observe whether the filter persists or resets.
cases.expected: Behavior is consistent and predictable (either filters persist across tabs or clearly reset) — flag to product if the actual behavior is inconsistent or unclear to the agent.

cases.title: Filter panel subtitle describes account filtering
steps: Open Filters on the Account list.
cases.expected: Subtitle relates to filtering wallet accounts. Design feedback: Figma 291:6675 shows 'Manage your team members and their account permission.', which is copy from another module.

cases.title: Account status options match the designed statuses
steps: Open the Account status field and list its options.
cases.expected: Options are Active, Suspended and Deactivated (Figma chips 'Active', 'Suspended', 'Deactivate').

cases.title: Balance range fields are empty by default and do not restrict results
steps: Read the Start amount / End amount fields before typing.
cases.expected: Both fields are empty with placeholders (Figma: 'XAF 500' / 'XAF 5.000.000' as hints). No pre-filled cap silently excludes accounts above a balance.

cases.title: Active filters are shown as removable chips above the table
cases.expected: Each active filter is displayed as a removable chip above the table (Figma 'Filters Flow' step 05).

cases.title: End date earlier than start date cannot be applied
steps: Pick a start date, then try an end date before it.
cases.expected: The end date before the start date is disabled or rejected with a message.

sections.name: Account Details
sections.pre: Agent is on the Account list and has opened an account's detail page (e.g. 'Nana Kouadio', Main wallet) which has a mix of completed and failed transactions of different types.

cases.title: Account Details page shows correct account metadata
steps: Compare displayed name, username, account type, balance, registration date, user type, status, and phone number against the source account.
cases.expected: Profile card shows avatar initials, @username (with copy icon), full name, status badge and phone; metadata shows Account type, Balance, Registration date and User type — all matching the selected account.
cases.note: Field set aligned with Figma 288:2628.

cases.title: 'View profile' link navigates to the account's Users Management profile
cases.expected: Agent is taken to the corresponding user's profile in Users Management, matching the wallet account owner.

cases.title: Transactions summary shows the correct 'Total amount deposited'
steps: Sum all completed deposit (cash-in) transactions for the account.
Compare to the 'Total amount deposited' summary figure.
cases.expected: Figure matches the sum of qualifying deposit transactions.

cases.title: Transactions summary shows the correct 'Highest deposit'
steps: Identify the largest single deposit transaction for the account.
Compare to the 'Highest deposit' summary figure.
cases.expected: Figure matches the largest qualifying deposit transaction amount.

cases.title: Transactions summary shows the correct 'Lowest deposit'
steps: Identify the smallest single deposit transaction for the account.
Compare to the 'Lowest deposit' summary figure.
cases.expected: Figure matches the smallest qualifying deposit transaction amount.

cases.title: Transactions summary shows the correct 'Total amount withdrawn'
steps: Sum all completed withdrawal (cash-out) transactions for the account.
Compare to the 'Total amount withdrawn' summary figure.
cases.expected: Figure matches the sum of qualifying withdrawal transactions.

cases.title: 'Back to account list' returns to the list preserving prior context
steps: From the Account list, apply a filter/search and open an account's details.
cases.expected: Agent returns to the Account list with the previous tab, filters, search, and page position preserved.

cases.title: 'Freeze account' button is present and clickable
steps: Locate the 'Freeze account' button on the Account Details page.
cases.expected: Button is visible (red, top-right) for an Active account and clicking it starts a freeze confirmation. Full freeze/unfreeze flow is out of scope until its screens are designed.
cases.note: Now automated: checks presence and that the click does not show a contradictory message.

cases.title: 'Manual operations' button opens a dropdown with 'Cash in' and 'Cash out'
steps: Click the 'Manual operations' button on the Account Details page.
cases.expected: A dropdown opens showing exactly two options: 'Cash in' and 'Cash out'.

cases.title: Transactions list shows correct columns
steps: Scroll to the transactions table on the Account Details page.
cases.expected: Table shows a row checkbox, Total amount, Transaction type, Payment method, Source/destination, Status, Date and 'See details'.
cases.note: Figma shows a row checkbox column.

cases.title: 'By transaction type' quick filter narrows the list to the selected type
cases.expected: Transactions list updates to show only transactions of the selected type.

cases.title: Transaction type badges display with correct color coding
steps: Inspect rows with different transaction types (Cash in, Cash out, Transfer from, Transfer to).
cases.expected: Each type renders as an outlined badge: Cash in / Transfer from in green, Cash out / Transfer to in red, with the exact labels.
cases.note: Colour mapping from Figma 288:2628.

cases.title: Status badges display with correct color coding
steps: Inspect rows with Completed and Failed statuses.
cases.expected: Completed shows a green ✓ 'Completed' badge; Failed shows a red × 'Failed' badge.

cases.title: 'See details' on a transaction row opens the correct Transaction Details panel
steps: Note the amount/date of a specific transaction row.
cases.expected: Transaction Details panel opens showing data matching exactly the row that was clicked.

cases.title: 'Export' button is present on the Account Details page
steps: Locate the 'Export' button above the transactions table.
cases.expected: Button is visible. The export form (date range, OTP confirmation) is deferred pending design.
cases.note: Presence is now automated.

cases.title: Breadcrumb shows 'Account list / @username'
cases.expected: Breadcrumb reads 'Account list / @username' of the opened account.

cases.title: Username copy icon copies the username
steps: Click the copy icon next to the @username.
cases.expected: Clipboard holds exactly the account's username.

cases.title: Metadata values use display labels, not raw keys
steps: Read Account type, User type and the status badge.
cases.expected: Values are capitalised display labels ('Main', 'Client', 'Active'), as in Figma.

cases.title: Balance is consistent with the transaction history
steps: Sum completed Cash in + Transfer from, minus completed Cash out + Transfer to, from the account's transaction list.
cases.expected: Balance equals the net of completed transactions (Figma 'Wallet Issue Flows — Balance mismatch' step 16).

cases.title: Transaction list pagination and result count work on Account Details
steps: Read 'Showing X to Y of Z results' under the account's transactions.
cases.expected: Count matches the number of rows; Per page changes the rows shown.

cases.title: Refresh icon reloads the account's transactions
steps: Click the refresh icon above the transactions table.
cases.expected: List reloads with the same rows and filters.

cases.title: 'By transaction type' lists every designed transaction type
cases.expected: Options cover every type that appears in the table: Cash in, Cash out, Transfer from, Transfer to.

sections.name: Transaction Filters (account level)
sections.pre: Agent is on an account's detail page which has a mix of completed and failed transactions of different types.

cases.title: Transaction 'Filters' panel opens with the expected fields
steps: On the Account Details transactions table, click 'Filters'.
cases.expected: Panel opens with Transaction status, Payment method, Source/Destination, Balance range, and Creation date fields.

cases.title: Filtering by 'Completed' status returns only completed transactions
cases.expected: Only transactions with Completed status are shown.

cases.title: Filtering by 'Failed' status returns only failed transactions
cases.expected: Only transactions with Failed status are shown.

cases.title: Filtering by payment method returns only matching transactions
steps: Select a specific payment method (e.g. Mobile Money).
cases.expected: Only transactions using the selected payment method are shown.

cases.title: Filtering by source/destination returns only matching transactions
steps: Select/enter a specific source or destination value.
cases.expected: Only transactions with that source/destination are shown.

cases.title: Filtering by balance/amount range returns only matching transactions
steps: Enter a start and end amount under Balance range.
cases.expected: Only transactions whose amount falls within the specified range are shown.

cases.title: Filtering by creation date range returns only matching transactions
steps: Choose a start and end date under Creation date.
cases.expected: Only transactions dated within the selected range are shown.

cases.title: Combining multiple transaction filter fields applies AND logic
steps: Set status, payment method, and a balance range together.
cases.expected: Only transactions satisfying all selected conditions simultaneously are returned.

cases.title: Resetting/clearing transaction filters restores the full unfiltered list
steps: Apply one or more transaction filters.
cases.expected: Full, unfiltered transactions list for the account is restored.

cases.title: Transaction status options use the designed labels
cases.expected: Options use the same labels as the status badges ('Completed', 'Failed', plus any other lifecycle status), consistently cased.

cases.title: 'Apply filters' is disabled until a value is set
cases.expected: 'Apply filters' is disabled.

cases.title: Closing the panel with × discards unapplied changes
cases.expected: The list is unchanged.

sections.name: Transaction Details (account level)
sections.pre: Agent has opened a Transaction Details panel for a specific transaction from the Account Details transactions list.

cases.title: Transaction Details panel displays core transaction fields correctly
steps: Open the Transaction Details panel for a known transaction.
Compare Total amount, Transaction type, Amount, Fees, Payment method, Source, Status, and Date against the source data.
cases.expected: Panel 'Transaction details' shows Total amount (large), Client, Transaction type, Amount, Fees, Payment method, Source, Status, Date, Transaction reference — all matching the record.
cases.note: Field list from Figma 306:9318.

cases.title: Transaction reference is displayed correctly
cases.pre: Agent has opened a Transaction Details panel.
cases.expected: The correct reference/ID value is shown, truncated with an icon if long, matching the underlying record.

cases.title: Copy-to-clipboard icon on Transaction reference copies the correct value
cases.pre: Agent has opened a Transaction Details panel.
steps: Click the copy icon next to 'Transaction reference'.
cases.expected: Pasted value exactly matches the full transaction reference (not the truncated display text).

cases.title: Transaction mode (Manual/Automatic) displays correctly
cases.pre: Agent has opened Transaction Details panels for one manual and one automatic transaction.
steps: Open details for a system-generated transaction.
Open details for an agent-initiated (manual) transaction.
cases.expected: 'Transaction mode' reads 'Automatic' for the system transaction and 'Manual' for the agent-initiated one.

cases.title: 'Initiated by' shows the correct identity for a manual transaction
cases.pre: Agent has opened Transaction Details for a manual transaction.
steps: Open details for a known manual transaction.
cases.expected: Field shows the username/handle of the admin who performed the manual action.

cases.title: 'Reason' field displays the recorded reason and any linked evidence
cases.pre: Agent has opened Transaction Details for a manual transaction with a recorded reason.
steps: Open details for a manual transaction.
Check the 'Reason' field and any attached link/icon.
cases.expected: The recorded reason text is shown in full, and any linked reference is present and functional.

cases.title: 'Reason' is hidden for automatic transactions; 'Initiated by' shows the client
cases.pre: Agent has opened Transaction Details for a system-generated (automatic) transaction.
steps: Open details for an automatic transaction.
cases.expected: 'Reason' is hidden. 'Initiated by' shows the client's @handle (Figma 484:19812 shows Initiated by '@cosmic_coder' on an Automatic transaction).
cases.note: v1 expected both fields hidden; Figma shows Initiated by on automatic transactions.

cases.title: Internal payment reference displays and truncates correctly
cases.pre: Agent has opened a Transaction Details panel.
steps: Compare the truncated display against the full value (via the copy icon).
cases.expected: Field is labelled 'Internal payment reference', truncated display is legible and the full value is retrievable via copy.
cases.note: Label name asserted (app shows 'Internal reference').

cases.title: Payment provider field displays correctly
cases.pre: Agent has opened a Transaction Details panel.
cases.expected: Correct payment provider/processor name (e.g. MAVIANCE) is shown for the transaction.

cases.title: Closing the panel returns to the transactions list unchanged
cases.pre: Agent has opened a Transaction Details panel from a filtered/paginated transactions list.
steps: Apply a filter or navigate to page 2 of the transactions list.
cases.expected: Agent returns to the transactions list with the same filter and page position as before opening the panel.

cases.title: Amount and Fees sum correctly to the displayed Total amount
cases.pre: Agent has opened a Transaction Details panel for a transaction with a non-zero fee.
steps: Open details for a transaction that has both Amount and Fees populated.
Compare to the Total amount shown at the top of the panel.
cases.expected: Total amount equals Amount + Fees with no rounding discrepancies.

cases.title: Transaction type and mode use display labels, not raw keys
steps: Read Transaction type and Transaction mode.
cases.expected: Display labels such as 'Cash in', 'Transfer from', 'Automatic' (Figma), never 'cash_in', 'transfer_from', 'automatic'.

cases.title: Status in the panel uses the designed badge
cases.expected: Status renders as the same badge as the list (✓ Completed green / × Failed red).

cases.title: Amount shown in the list matches the panel's Total amount
steps: Note the Total amount of a row.
cases.expected: The row's Total amount equals the panel's Total amount.

sections.name: Manual Operations — Cash In (Manual Deposit)
sections.pre: Agent is on an account's detail page (Main wallet).

cases.title: Selecting 'Cash in' from Manual operations opens the Manual deposit flow
cases.expected: Agent is taken to the 'Manual deposit' screen (breadcrumb: Account list / ... / Manual deposit), on the 'Payment information' step of the stepper.

cases.title: Deposit amount field accepts numeric input only
cases.pre: Agent is on the Manual deposit — Payment information step.
steps: Attempt to type letters/symbols into 'Deposit amount'.
Attempt to type a valid number.
cases.expected: Non-numeric characters are rejected; numeric values are accepted and displayed correctly.

cases.title: Deposit amount rejects zero or negative values
cases.pre: Agent is on the Manual deposit — Payment information step.
steps: Attempt to proceed. Repeat with a negative number.
cases.expected: A validation error is shown and the agent cannot proceed with a zero/negative deposit amount.

cases.title: 'Review details' is disabled until required fields are completed
cases.pre: Agent is on the Manual deposit — Payment information step.
cases.expected: Button remains disabled until Deposit amount and Payment method (and any other required fields) are filled.

cases.title: Selecting 'Mobile Money' reveals Payment operator and Transaction ID reference fields
cases.pre: Agent is on the Manual deposit — Payment information step.
cases.expected: Two additional fields appear: 'Payment operator' (operator name + phone number) and 'Transaction ID reference'.

cases.title: Payment operator dropdown lists valid operators with correct phone numbers
cases.pre: Agent has selected 'Mobile Money' as the payment method.
cases.expected: Operators shown (e.g. 'Orange Money +237696910950') are labelled with operator name and a valid phone number.

cases.title: Transaction ID reference field accepts and retains the entered value
cases.pre: Agent has selected 'Mobile Money' as the payment method.
cases.expected: The exact value entered is retained and shown unmodified on the Review details step.

cases.title: 'Reason of the operation' is required before proceeding
cases.pre: Agent is on the Manual deposit — Payment information step with amount and payment method filled.
cases.expected: Agent cannot proceed without entering a reason; a validation indicator is shown.

cases.title: Valid data proceeds to an accurate Review details summary
cases.pre: Agent has filled all required fields on the Manual deposit — Payment information step.
steps: Enter a valid amount, payment method (+ operator/reference if Mobile Money), and reason.
cases.expected: Review details step shows Client, Wallet type, Transaction type ('Cash in'), Amount, Payment method, Source, Date, Payment reference, and Reason — all matching what was entered.

cases.title: 'Back' from Review details returns to Payment information with entered values retained
cases.pre: Agent is on the Manual deposit — Review details step.
cases.expected: Agent returns to Payment information with all previously entered values (amount, payment method, operator, reference, reason) still populated.

cases.title: Payment reference is copyable via the copy icon on Review details
cases.pre: Agent is on the Manual deposit — Review details step.
steps: Click the copy icon next to 'Payment reference'.
cases.expected: Pasted value exactly matches the payment reference shown.

cases.title: Confirmation info box shows a message relevant to a deposit confirmation
cases.pre: Agent is on the Manual deposit — Review details step.
steps: Read the info box text below the summary.
cases.expected: Message relates to confirming a manual deposit. Defect if it shows the TOTP/authenticator-reset copy (present in Figma 431:12624 AND in the app — design + dev fix).
cases.note: Now automated.

cases.title: 'Confirm deposit' submits the manual deposit successfully
cases.pre: Agent is on the Manual deposit — Review details step with accurate data. Requires PHX_ALLOW_MONEY_OPS=true.
cases.expected: Submission succeeds; agent sees a clear success confirmation with the transaction reference and is returned to the Account Details page.
cases.note: Figma doc step 08–10: OTP + success with reference.

cases.title: Successful manual deposit updates the account balance immediately
cases.pre: Agent has just confirmed a manual deposit of a known amount.
steps: Note the account balance before the deposit.
Check the balance on Account Details.
cases.expected: Balance increases by exactly the deposited amount.

cases.title: Successful manual deposit appears correctly in the transactions list
cases.pre: Agent has just confirmed a manual deposit.
steps: Locate the new transaction at the top of the transactions list.
cases.expected: Transaction shows type 'Cash in', correct amount/payment method, Transaction mode = 'Manual', correct 'Initiated by' (the agent), and the entered reason.

cases.title: Manual deposit event is recorded in the audit trail
cases.pre: Agent has just confirmed a manual deposit.
steps: As an auditor, check the audit trail for this action.
cases.expected: Entry records agent identity, target account, amount, payment method, reason, and timestamp.

cases.title: 'Cancel' discards the in-progress deposit
cases.pre: Agent is on the Manual deposit — Payment information step with some fields filled.
cases.expected: Agent returns to Account Details; no transaction is created; entered data is discarded.

cases.title: Closing the panel ('X') at any step discards the in-progress deposit
cases.pre: Agent is mid-way through the Manual deposit flow (either step).
steps: Click the 'X' in the top-right corner.
cases.expected: Panel closes, no transaction is created, and agent returns to Account Details.

cases.title: Agent without manual-operations permission cannot access the Manual deposit flow
cases.pre: Agent is logged in with a role that lacks manual-operations permission.
steps: Look for the 'Manual operations' button, and attempt direct navigation to the Manual deposit URL.
cases.expected: Button is hidden/disabled for this role, and direct navigation is blocked (redirected or shown a permission error).

cases.title: Payment method options and the 'Cash' path
cases.expected: Options are listed (Mobile Money + other configured methods); choosing a non-Mobile-Money method does not require Payment operator / Transaction ID reference.

cases.title: Field labels match the design
steps: Read the labels on Payment information.
cases.expected: Labels are 'Deposit amount', 'Payment method', 'Payment operator', 'Transaction ID reference', 'Reason of the operation' (Figma 431:12305).

cases.title: Stepper shows the two steps and marks progress
steps: Observe the stepper on Payment information.
cases.expected: Stepper lists 'Payment information' and 'Review details'; the current step is highlighted and a completed step shows a ✓.

cases.title: Review step header and breadcrumb
cases.expected: Heading 'Review details'; breadcrumb stays 'Account list / ... / Manual deposit'.

cases.title: Page subtitle is relevant to a deposit
cases.expected: No unrelated copy. Defect if it reads 'Ensure the documents are clear and visible.' (no document upload exists in this form).

cases.title: Reaching 'Review details' does not create a transaction
steps: Fill the form, click 'Review details', then Cancel/close.
cases.expected: No new transaction (pending or otherwise) appears until 'Confirm deposit' is clicked.
cases.note: The app creates a server-side id when entering Review (URL /manual-deposit/<id>/verify).

cases.title: OTP is required to confirm a manual deposit
cases.pre: Requires PHX_ALLOW_MONEY_OPS=true.
cases.expected: An OTP step is shown before the deposit is recorded (Figma doc step 08).

cases.title: 'Do you need help?' is available in the flow header
steps: Look at the top-right of the Manual deposit screen.
cases.expected: 'Do you need help?' and the close (X) button are shown.

sections.name: Manual Operations — Cash Out (Manual Withdrawal)
sections.pre: Agent is on an account's detail page (Main wallet) with a positive balance.

cases.title: Selecting 'Cash out' from Manual operations opens the Manual withdrawal flow
cases.expected: Agent is taken to the 'Manual withdrawal' screen (breadcrumb: Account list / ... / Manual withdrawal), on the 'Payment information' step.

cases.title: Withdrawal amount field accepts numeric input only
cases.pre: Agent is on the Manual withdrawal — Payment information step.
steps: Attempt to type letters/symbols into 'Withdrawal amount'.
Attempt to type a valid number.
cases.expected: Non-numeric characters are rejected; numeric values are accepted and displayed correctly.

cases.title: Withdrawal amount cannot exceed the account's current balance
cases.pre: Agent is on the Manual withdrawal — Payment information step; 'Empty entire account' is OFF.
steps: Enter an amount greater than the account's current balance.
cases.expected: A validation error is shown; agent cannot proceed with an amount exceeding the available balance.

cases.title: Toggling 'Empty entire account' ON switches the flow to a full withdrawal
cases.pre: Agent is on the Manual withdrawal — Payment information step.
cases.expected: Amount field shows the full balance and is locked (greyed) — Figma 441:12933.

cases.title: Amount field behavior when 'Empty entire account' is ON matches the toggle's intent
cases.pre: Agent is on the Manual withdrawal — Payment information step with a manually entered amount already present.
steps: Type a partial amount (e.g. 1,000) into 'Withdrawal amount'.
cases.expected: Amount field updates to the full balance and becomes read-only once the toggle is on.
cases.note: Now automated.

cases.title: Toggling 'Empty entire account' OFF restores partial-withdrawal behavior
cases.pre: Agent has 'Empty entire account' enabled.
cases.expected: Amount field is re-enabled for manual entry and no longer locked to the full balance.

cases.title: Selecting 'Mobile Money' reveals the Payment operator field
cases.pre: Agent is on the Manual withdrawal — Payment information step.
cases.expected: A 'Payment operator' field appears (operator name with phone number/destination).

cases.title: 'Reason of the operation' is required before proceeding
cases.pre: Agent is on the Manual withdrawal — Payment information step with amount and payment method filled.
cases.expected: Agent cannot proceed without entering a reason; a validation indicator is shown.

cases.title: 'Review details' is disabled until required fields are completed
cases.pre: Agent is on the Manual withdrawal — Payment information step.
cases.expected: Button remains disabled until required fields are filled.

cases.title: Review details for a partial withdrawal shows correct data
cases.pre: Agent has filled the Manual withdrawal form with 'Empty entire account' OFF.
steps: Enter a partial amount, payment method/operator, and reason.
cases.expected: Review details shows Client, Wallet type, Transaction type ('Cash out'), Withdrawal type = 'Partial withdrawal', Amount, Payment method, Destination, Date, Payment reference, and Reason — all matching the form.

cases.title: Review details for a full withdrawal shows correct data
cases.pre: Agent has enabled 'Empty entire account' on the Manual withdrawal form.
cases.expected: Review details shows Withdrawal type = 'Full withdrawal' (or equivalent), and Amount equal to the account's full balance.

cases.title: 'Back' from Review details returns to Payment information with values (including toggle state) retained
cases.pre: Agent is on the Manual withdrawal — Review details step.
cases.expected: Agent returns to Payment information with all previously entered values and the 'Empty entire account' toggle state preserved.

cases.title: Payment reference is copyable via the copy icon on Review details
cases.pre: Agent is on the Manual withdrawal — Review details step.
steps: Click the copy icon next to 'Payment reference'.
cases.expected: Pasted value exactly matches the payment reference shown.

cases.title: Confirmation info box shows a message relevant to a withdrawal confirmation
cases.pre: Agent is on the Manual withdrawal — Review details step.
steps: Read the info box text below the summary.
cases.expected: Message relates to confirming a manual withdrawal. Defect if it shows the TOTP/authenticator-reset copy (in Figma 441:12952 and the app).
cases.note: Now automated.

cases.title: 'Confirm withdrawal' submits the manual withdrawal successfully
cases.pre: Agent is on the Manual withdrawal — Review details step with accurate data. Requires PHX_ALLOW_MONEY_OPS=true.
cases.expected: Submission succeeds; agent sees a clear success confirmation and is returned to the Account Details page.

cases.title: Successful partial withdrawal updates the account balance correctly
cases.pre: Agent has just confirmed a partial manual withdrawal of a known amount.
steps: Note the balance before the withdrawal.
Check the balance on Account Details.
cases.expected: Balance decreases by exactly the withdrawn amount (plus fees if 'Automatic fees calculation' is on).

cases.title: Successful full withdrawal results in a zero balance
cases.pre: Agent has just confirmed a full withdrawal via 'Empty entire account'.
steps: Check the balance on Account Details.
cases.expected: Balance is exactly 0 XAF after the withdrawal.
cases.note: Kept manual: empties the shared test account.

cases.title: Successful manual withdrawal appears correctly in the transactions list
cases.pre: Agent has just confirmed a manual withdrawal.
steps: Locate the new transaction at the top of the transactions list.
cases.expected: Transaction shows type 'Cash out', correct amount/payment method, Transaction mode = 'Manual', correct 'Initiated by' (the agent), and the entered reason.

cases.title: Manual withdrawal event is recorded in the audit trail
cases.pre: Agent has just confirmed a manual withdrawal.
steps: As an auditor, check the audit trail for this action.
cases.expected: Entry records agent identity, target account, amount, withdrawal type (partial/full), payment method, reason, and timestamp.

cases.title: 'Cancel' discards the in-progress withdrawal
cases.pre: Agent is on the Manual withdrawal — Payment information step with some fields filled.
cases.expected: Agent returns to Account Details; no transaction is created; entered data is discarded.

cases.title: Closing the panel ('X') at any step discards the in-progress withdrawal
cases.pre: Agent is mid-way through the Manual withdrawal flow (either step).
steps: Click the 'X' in the top-right corner.
cases.expected: Panel closes, no transaction is created, and agent returns to Account Details.

cases.title: Agent without manual-operations permission cannot access the Manual withdrawal flow
cases.pre: Agent is logged in with a role that lacks manual-operations permission.
steps: Look for the 'Manual operations' button, and attempt direct navigation to the Manual withdrawal URL.
cases.expected: Button is hidden/disabled for this role, and direct navigation is blocked (redirected or shown a permission error).

cases.title: Zero or negative withdrawal amount is rejected
cases.expected: A validation error is shown and 'Review details' stays disabled.

cases.title: Review shows Payment method and Destination separately
steps: Fill the form with Mobile Money + an operator.
cases.expected: 'Payment method' shows the method/operator brand (Figma: 'Orange Money') and 'Destination' shows the phone number; the account holder's name is not shown as the payment method.

cases.title: Extra fee toggles not in the design are confirmed with product
cases.expected: Figma 441:12933 has no fee toggles. The app shows 'Automatic fees calculation' and 'Charge subscription fees' (both ON). Product to confirm; if kept, their values must appear on Review details.

cases.title: Reaching 'Review details' does not create a transaction
steps: Fill the form, click 'Review details', then close.
cases.expected: No new transaction appears until 'Confirm withdrawal' is clicked.

cases.title: OTP is required to confirm a manual withdrawal
cases.pre: Requires PHX_ALLOW_MONEY_OPS=true.
cases.expected: An OTP step is shown before the withdrawal is processed (Figma doc step 07).

cases.title: Field labels and subtitle match the design
steps: Read the Payment information labels and subtitle.
cases.expected: Labels 'Withdrawal amount', 'Empty entire account — withdraw the entire balance.', 'Payment method', 'Payment operator', 'Reason of the operation'; no unrelated subtitle such as 'Ensure the documents are clear and visible.'

cases.title: Withdrawal on a zero-balance account is blocked with a clear message
cases.pre: An account with 0 XAF balance.
steps: Open Manual operations > Cash out on a 0-balance account.
cases.expected: The form explains the balance is insufficient (Figma doc: 'Insufficient balance error state') and does not allow review.

sections.name: Transactions Module — List (Deposits / Withdrawals / Sales / Purchases)
sections.pre: Agent is logged into the Admin Panel with a CS role; Fiat Wallet > Transactions shows transactions across all accounts, split into Deposits, Withdrawals, Sales, and Purchases tabs.

cases.title: Transactions module loads with 4 tabs, defaulting to Deposits
steps: Open Fiat Wallet > Transactions from the sidebar.
cases.expected: Page loads with 'Deposits', 'Withdrawals', 'Sales', and 'Purchases' tabs; 'Deposits' is selected by default.

cases.title: Deposits tab shows the correct columns
cases.expected: Columns are Username, Total amount, Payment method, Source/Destination, Status, and Date.

cases.title: Withdrawals tab shows the correct columns
cases.expected: Columns are Username, Total amount, Payment method, Source/Destination, Status, and Date.

cases.title: Sales tab shows the correct columns
cases.expected: Columns are Username, Total amount, Source/Destination, Product, Status, and Date (Product replaces Payment method).

cases.title: Purchases tab shows the correct columns
cases.expected: Columns are Username, Total amount, Source/Destination, Product, Status, and Date, matching the Sales tab structure.

cases.title: Switching tabs loads that type's data and resets to page 1
steps: Navigate to page 2 or 3 on the Deposits tab.
cases.expected: Withdrawals tab loads its own data set starting at page 1, independent of the Deposits tab's pagination state.

cases.title: Search by username filters the current tab's list
steps: On any tab, enter a known username in the search box.
cases.expected: List narrows to only transactions belonging to that username, within the current tab.

cases.title: Row and select-all checkboxes work correctly
steps: Click the header checkbox to select all rows on the page.
cases.expected: Individual selection toggles that row only; header checkbox selects/deselects all rows currently visible on the page.

cases.title: Pagination (per page, page numbers, next/prev) works on each tab
steps: On each of the 4 tabs, change 'Per page', click a page number, and use next/prev arrows.
cases.expected: List updates correctly for each control, independently on every tab.

cases.title: Result count label reflects the current tab/filter/page
steps: Note 'Showing X to Y of Z results'.
Switch tabs, apply a filter, or change page.
cases.expected: Label reads 'Showing X to Y of Z results' (no stray comma) and updates after each change.

cases.title: Refresh icon reloads the current tab's list
cases.expected: A loading state is briefly shown, then the current tab reloads with up-to-date data.

cases.title: 'See details' opens the correct Transaction Details panel on every tab
steps: On each tab, note a specific row's username/amount.
cases.expected: Details panel opens with data matching exactly the row clicked, for all 4 tabs.

cases.title: Status badges render with correct color coding across all tabs
steps: Inspect Completed and Failed rows on each tab.
cases.expected: Completed shows a green/success indicator, Failed shows a red/error indicator, consistently across all 4 tabs.

cases.title: 'Export' button is present on the Transactions module page
steps: Locate the 'Export' button above the table, on any tab.
cases.expected: Button is visible. The export flow itself is deferred pending design.
cases.note: Presence is now automated.

cases.title: Transactions module shows data across ALL accounts, not one user
steps: Open Fiat Wallet > Transactions directly from the sidebar.
Confirm multiple distinct usernames appear in the list.
cases.expected: List aggregates transactions from all wallet accounts.

cases.title: Page header shows title and description
cases.expected: Title 'Transactions' and description 'The transaction list covers all wallet movements and allows you to isolate a case quickly.' (Figma copy has the typo 'cover'/'allow'); breadcrumb 'Transactions list'.

cases.title: Search by transaction reference finds the transaction
steps: Copy a transaction reference from a details panel.
Paste it into the search box.
cases.expected: Only that transaction is listed (Figma 'Transactions List Flow' step 04: search by username or reference).

cases.title: Default sort shows the most recent transactions first
cases.expected: Dates are in descending order (recent-activity sorting, Figma doc step 02).

cases.title: Product column shows product display names
cases.expected: Product names such as 'Savings Box', 'Goal Savings', 'Bond Investment' — never raw keys like 'bond_investment'.

cases.title: Same transaction shows the same total in the module and on Account Details
steps: Find a known account's deposit in the Deposits tab.
Find the same transaction on the account's details page.
cases.expected: Total amount is identical in both lists (both show amount incl. fees, or both excl.).

sections.name: Transactions Module — Filters
sections.pre: Agent is logged into the Admin Panel with a CS role; Fiat Wallet > Transactions is available with Deposits, Withdrawals, Sales, and Purchases tabs.

cases.title: Deposits 'Filters' panel shows the expected field set
cases.expected: Panel shows Transaction status, Payment method, Balance range (Start/End amount), and Creation date. (No Source/Destination field at this list level.)

cases.title: Withdrawals 'Filters' panel matches the Deposits field set
cases.expected: Panel shows the same fields as Deposits: Transaction status, Payment method, Balance range, Creation date.

cases.title: Sales 'Filters' panel shows Product instead of Payment method
cases.expected: Panel shows Transaction status, Product, Balance range, and Creation date (Figma 514:22583).

cases.title: Purchases 'Filters' panel matches the Sales field set
cases.expected: Panel shows the same fields as Sales: Transaction status, Product, Balance range, Creation date.

cases.title: Filtering Deposits/Withdrawals by transaction status returns only matching rows
cases.expected: Only transactions with the selected status are shown; the page never errors.

cases.title: Filtering Deposits/Withdrawals by payment method returns only matching rows
cases.expected: Only transactions using the selected payment method are shown.

cases.title: Filtering Sales/Purchases by product returns only matching rows
cases.expected: Only transactions linked to the selected product are shown.

cases.title: Filtering by balance/amount range works on every tab
steps: Open Filters on each tab in turn.
cases.expected: Only transactions with an amount within the specified range are shown, on each tab.

cases.title: Filtering by creation date range works on every tab
steps: Open Filters on each tab in turn.
cases.expected: Only transactions dated within the selected range are shown, on each tab.

cases.title: Combining multiple filter fields applies AND logic on every tab
steps: On any tab, set status + payment method (or product) + amount range together.
cases.expected: Only transactions satisfying all selected conditions simultaneously are returned.

cases.title: 'Reset' clears all filter values without closing the panel
steps: Open Filters and set several values.
cases.expected: All fields return to default/empty state; panel stays open.

cases.title: 'Apply filters' is disabled until a value is set or changed
steps: Open Filters without changing any field.
cases.expected: Button remains disabled until at least one filter criterion is set.

cases.title: Filter state is well-defined when switching tabs
steps: Apply a filter on one tab (e.g. Deposits).
Switch to another tab (e.g. Sales) whose filter fields differ.
cases.expected: Filters either reset per tab or map sensibly; flag to product if a value that doesn't apply to the new tab is carried over.

cases.title: Panel subtitle and field labels match the design
cases.expected: Subtitle 'Manage users transactions.'; range field labelled 'Balance range' with 'Start amount' / 'End amount' and 'Creation date' (Figma 514:22583).

cases.title: Range fields are empty by default and do not restrict results
cases.expected: Start/End amount are empty (placeholders only); no pre-filled maximum silently hides large transactions.

sections.name: Transaction Details — Deposits & Withdrawals
sections.pre: Agent is on Fiat Wallet > Transactions (Deposits or Withdrawals tab) and has opened a transaction's details panel.

cases.title: Deposit transaction details show all expected fields
steps: Open details for a known Deposit transaction.
Compare Total amount, Client, Transaction type ('Cash in'), Amount, Fees, Payment method, Source, Status, Date, and Transaction reference against the source data.
cases.expected: All fields are present and match the underlying transaction record.

cases.title: Withdrawal transaction details show all expected fields
steps: Open details for a known Withdrawal transaction.
Compare Total amount, Client, Transaction type ('Cash out'), Amount, Fees, Payment method, Source, Status, Date, and Transaction reference.
cases.expected: All fields are present and match the underlying transaction record.

cases.title: Manual transaction shows Transaction mode, Initiated by, and Reason
steps: Open details for a transaction known to be manually initiated.
cases.expected: Transaction mode reads 'Manual'; 'Initiated by' shows the acting agent's username; 'Reason' shows the recorded reason text.

cases.title: Automatic transaction hides Reason
steps: Open details for a system-generated transaction.
cases.expected: Transaction mode reads 'Automatic'; 'Reason' row is hidden; 'Initiated by' shows the client handle (Figma 484:19812).
cases.note: Aligned with Figma: Initiated by is shown on automatic transactions.

cases.title: Internal payment reference and Payment provider display correctly
steps: Open details for any Deposit or Withdrawal transaction.
Check the bottom section of the panel.
cases.expected: 'Internal payment reference' (with copy icon) and 'Payment provider' are shown with values.

cases.title: 'Reason' field respects its designed character allowance
steps: Open details for a manual transaction whose reason is near the field's limit (~40 characters).
Inspect how the text is displayed.
cases.expected: Full reason text is legible — either fully shown or truncated with a way to view the complete text.

cases.title: 'Complete transaction' button appears on a Failed deposit's details panel
cases.pre: A Deposit transaction with Status = Failed exists.
steps: Open details for a Failed deposit transaction.
Observe the bottom of the panel.
cases.expected: A 'Complete transaction' action button is visible in the panel footer (Figma 484:19812).

cases.title: 'Complete transaction' does NOT appear on a Completed deposit's details panel
steps: Open details for a Completed deposit transaction.
Observe the bottom of the panel.
cases.expected: No 'Complete transaction' (or similar) action is shown; the panel is read-only.

cases.title: Clicking 'Complete transaction' starts the completion flow
cases.pre: Agent has opened the Transaction Details panel for a Failed deposit transaction.
cases.expected: The Complete transaction page opens (see section 12 for the full flow).
cases.note: Flow now designed as a 2-step page (Figma 2098:143942); detailed in section 12.

cases.title: Completing a failed deposit is recorded in the audit trail
cases.pre: Agent has just completed a previously failed deposit.
steps: As an auditor, check the audit trail for this action.
cases.expected: Entry records the agent's identity, the transaction reference, the prior/new status, and a timestamp.

cases.title: Confirm whether 'Complete transaction' exists for a Failed withdrawal
cases.pre: A Withdrawal transaction with Status = Failed exists.
steps: Open details for a Failed withdrawal transaction.
Observe the bottom of the panel.
cases.expected: Figma 487:20464 (Withdrawal - Failed) to be checked with product: no retry exists (Figma 'Support Gaps': no retry action on failed withdrawals).

cases.title: Closing the panel returns to the list without altering its state
cases.expected: Agent returns to the list with the same filter and page position as before opening the panel.

cases.title: Copy-to-clipboard icons copy the full, untruncated value
steps: Click the copy icon next to 'Transaction reference'.
Click the copy icon next to 'Internal payment reference'.
cases.expected: Each pasted value exactly matches the complete underlying value, not the truncated on-screen display.

cases.title: Client and Source are consistent with the row
steps: Compare Client with the row's Username.
cases.expected: Client equals the row's @username; Source matches the row's Source/Destination.

sections.name: Transaction Details — Sales & Purchases
sections.pre: Agent is on Fiat Wallet > Transactions (Sales or Purchases tab) and has opened a transaction's details panel.

cases.title: Sales transaction details show all expected fields
steps: Open details for a known Sales transaction.
Compare Total amount, Client, Transaction type ('Transfer from'), Amount, Destination, Source, Product, Status, Date, and Transaction reference.
cases.expected: All fields are present and match the underlying transaction record.

cases.title: Purchases transaction details show all expected fields
steps: Open details for a known Purchases transaction.
Compare Total amount, Client, Transaction type ('Transfer to'), Amount, Destination, Source, Product, Status, Date, and Transaction reference.
cases.expected: All fields are present and match the underlying transaction record.

cases.title: Manual Sales/Purchases transaction shows Transaction mode, Initiated by, and Reason
steps: Open details for a manually initiated Sales or Purchases transaction.
cases.expected: Transaction mode reads 'Manual'; 'Initiated by' and 'Reason' are populated correctly.

cases.title: Automatic Sales/Purchases transaction hides Reason
steps: Open details for a system-generated Sales or Purchases transaction.
cases.expected: Transaction mode reads 'Automatic'; 'Reason' is hidden.

cases.title: Payment operator and Payment provider display correctly
steps: Open details for any Sales or Purchases transaction.
Check the bottom section of the panel.
cases.expected: 'Payment operator' and 'Payment provider' are shown with values (this replaces 'Internal payment reference' seen on Deposits/Withdrawals).

cases.title: Product field correctly reflects the originating module
steps: Open details for transactions linked to different products.
cases.expected: The 'Product' field names the module the sale or purchase relates to, matching the row's Product column.

cases.title: Source and Destination are consistent with transaction direction
steps: Open details for a Sales transaction and note Source/Destination.
Open details for a Purchases transaction and note Source/Destination.
cases.expected: For a Sale, Source is the product module and Destination is 'Main wallet'; for a Purchase, this is reversed.

cases.title: Confirm presence/absence of a completion action on Failed Sales/Purchases transactions
steps: Open details for a Failed Sales (or Purchases) transaction.
Observe the bottom of the panel.
cases.expected: Confirmed with product (Rose, Oct 2026): no 'Complete transaction' action on Sales/Purchases.
cases.note: Automated on any Sales row: action must be absent.

cases.title: Closing the panel returns to the list without altering its state
cases.expected: Agent returns to the list with the same filter and page position as before opening the panel.

sections.name: Complete Transaction (failed deposit)
sections.pre: A Deposit with Status = Failed exists; agent opened its Transaction details panel and clicked 'Complete transaction'. Steps that confirm require PHX_ALLOW_MONEY_OPS=true.

cases.title: 'Complete transaction' opens the Complete transaction page
steps: Click 'Complete transaction' on a failed deposit's details panel.
cases.expected: Full-page flow opens with breadcrumb 'Account list / … / Complete transaction', stepper 'Payment information → Review details', on Payment information.

cases.title: Internal payment reference is pre-filled and read-only
cases.expected: Field shows the failed transaction's internal payment reference, greyed and not editable (Figma 2098:145579).

cases.title: Reason is required before reviewing
cases.expected: 'Review details' is disabled while the reason is empty and enabled once it is filled (Figma 2098:145579 vs 2098:145686).

cases.title: Review details summarises the completion
cases.expected: Review shows Client, Wallet type, Transaction type 'Complete cash in', Amount of the failed deposit and Reason (with eye icon to view it in full).

cases.title: Review step labels belong to the Complete-transaction flow
steps: Read the breadcrumb and primary button on Review details.
cases.expected: Breadcrumb reads 'Complete transaction' and the button names the completion. Design feedback: Figma 2098:145803 shows breadcrumb 'Manual deposit' and button 'Confirm deposit'.

cases.title: Info box copy relates to completing a transaction
steps: Read the info box on Review details.
cases.expected: Copy relates to confirming the completion (Figma shows the TOTP-reset text — design defect).

cases.title: 'Back' keeps the entered reason
cases.expected: Payment information shows the same reason and reference.

cases.title: 'Cancel' / 'X' leave the transaction Failed
cases.expected: Agent returns to the list/details; status is still Failed; balance unchanged.

cases.title: Confirming completes the deposit and credits the wallet
cases.pre: Requires PHX_ALLOW_MONEY_OPS=true.
steps: Confirm on Review details (OTP if prompted).
Re-open the transaction and the account.
cases.expected: Status becomes Completed; balance increases by the deposit amount exactly once; success confirmation shown.

cases.title: A completed transaction cannot be completed twice
cases.pre: Requires PHX_ALLOW_MONEY_OPS=true.
steps: After TC-COMPTX-009, re-open the same transaction.
cases.expected: 'Complete transaction' is no longer offered (no double credit).

cases.title: Completed transaction records who completed it and why
cases.pre: Requires PHX_ALLOW_MONEY_OPS=true.
cases.expected: Transaction mode 'Manual', Initiated by = the agent, Reason = the entered reason.

sections.name: Wallet Issue Resolution (end-to-end CS paths)
sections.pre: Agent is logged in with a CS role and handling a customer ticket.

cases.title: Deposit not reflected: agent can trace a deposit from the account
steps: Search the wallet account by name or username.
Open details, filter the transaction list by Pending/Failed.
Open the deposit and verify reference, source and status.
cases.expected: Every step is possible from the Fiat Wallet module without errors; reference, source and status are visible.

cases.title: Withdrawal failed: agent can find a withdrawal by transaction ID
steps: In Transactions > Withdrawals search by transaction ID.
cases.expected: The withdrawal is found and its status, payout method and provider are shown.

cases.title: Balance mismatch: wallet balance can be reconciled with history
steps: Compare the account balance with the transaction history totals.
cases.expected: Balance equals the net of completed transactions (automated in TC-WALLDET-019).

cases.title: Transfer dispute: agent can isolate transfers
cases.expected: Transfers can be isolated. Figma gap: no transfer filter exists — confirm with product.
